Named a shape from its sides and corners, including when tilted.

end.parentNote: Asha practised counting each side once by tracing around the shape and naming corners. Ayaan correctly explained that a shape still has the same number of sides when it is tilted, but they were unsure where to begin counting. At home, draw simple shapes and ask Ayaan to mark the starting corner before tracing around each shape once.
